sloka: भवन्तश्च समानीता भरतेन महात्मना ।श्रुत्वा जनकराजस्य काननात्तनयां हृताम् ।। ७.३८.२५ ॥
transliteration: bhavantaśca samānītā bharatena mahātmanā ।śrutvā janakarājasya kānanāttanayāṁ hṛtām ।। 7.38.25 ॥

translations.english: You all were brought here by the great-souled Bharata, having heard that King Janaka's daughter was abducted from the forest.
